message.content: {"caption":"Empirical distributions of evolved-minus-initial line-count changes for Refine and Repair tasks, separated by pass or fail outcome.","description":"Two side-by-side empirical cumulative distribution function (ECDF) plots. The left plot is Refine (n = 43), and the right is Repair (n = 46). In both, the horizontal axis is change in lines (evolved − initial) on a symmetric log scale, and the vertical axis is ECDF from 0 to 1. Solid blue lines represent passing tasks and dashed red lines represent failing tasks; dotted vertical lines mark zero change. The legends report 39 passes and 4 failures for Refine, and 28 passes and 18 failures for Repair.
